optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Embedded Software Engineer, E-bike Drive Systems

professionalSummary.text: Embedded Software Engineer with experience writing C firmware for STM32 microcontrollers in motor control and battery management systems at Velomark Cycles.
professionalSummary.witness: Wrote field-oriented control firmware in C for the STM32G4 motor controller at Velomark Cycles, including current-loop tuning and stall protection.

professionalSummary.text: Developed and documented 31 CAN diagnostic trouble codes for battery pack and motor controller systems, verified by Velomark's firmware lead.
professionalSummary.witness: Added 31 CAN diagnostic trouble codes for the battery pack and motor controller and documented them for the service-tool team.

experienceHighlights.text: Reduced hardware-in-the-loop regression suite runtime from 95 minutes to 38 minutes by parallelizing test groups across two rig channels, as documented in CI pipeline logs.
experienceHighlights.witness: Cut the hardware-in-the-loop regression suite from 95 minutes to 38 minutes between March and May 2023 by running independent test groups in parallel on two rig channels, as recorded in the CI pipeline logs.

experienceHighlights.text: Maintained and enhanced the over-the-air update pipeline with signature verification and rollback functionality for firmware updates delivered through the companion app.
experienceHighlights.witness: Maintained the over-the-air update pipeline that signs firmware images and stages them for the companion app, and added a rollback check for failed installs.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: CI pipeline history excerpt showing regression suite runtime reduction from 95 minutes (March 2023) to 38 minutes (May 2023) with parallel test execution.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: an excerpt of the CI pipeline history for the hardware-in-the-loop suite, showing run durations for March 2023 (median 95 minutes) and May 2023 (median 38 minutes) and the pipeline change that split the suite across two rig channels.

skills.text: C programming for STM32 microcontrollers, CAN bus diagnostics, hardware-in-the-loop testing, over-the-air firmware updates.
skills.witness: Wrote field-oriented control firmware in C for the STM32G4 motor controller at Velomark Cycles, including current-loop tuning and stall protection.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's work on STM32 firmware, CAN diagnostics, hardware-in-the-loop test suite optimization, and OTA update pipeline. The materials do not establish measured effects of firmware changes on range or energy use from a test-protocol report with baseline firmware, load, and route.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review required to assess evidence gaps and interview signals.
